# Visionwrit

> Visionwrit is a vision board and asks journal app for Android. People write what they hope for as clear, specific "asks" with a photo, read them every morning and night, and look back every 6 or 12 months to count what they have received. It is built on Habakkuk 2:2: "Write the vision, and make it plain." Visionwrit is a Leonem Group LLC company.

Key facts:
- Platform: launching on Android (Google Play) in December 2026, with iPhone (App Store) planned for spring 2027.
- Price: free to start (up to 20 asks, one reading reminder). Visionwrit Plus costs $19.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, $3.99 a month, or $49.99 once for lifetime access. Plus is purchased in the app and billed through the app store.
- Privacy: no account is needed to start; asks are stored on the user's phone. Optional app lock and PDF export.
- Faith is part of the foundation but never forced: Today's word mixes Bible verses (World English Bible) with gratitude and wisdom quotes, and Scripture can be turned off.
- Make it plain meter: checks each ask for four things (what it is, details, a name or number, a when or where) and suggests what to add. It never blocks saving.
- Support: support@visionwrit.com or the contact form at https://visionwrit.com/help#contact
